title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Hungarian Grand Prix?
background: The Hungarian Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official race classification published by Formula One or the FIA. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the Hungarian Grand Prix scheduled for July 26, 2026. This concerns the Grand Prix itself, not any sprint race. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning driver's full name.
